# PRINT MANIFEST -- TUBE-FILLER

<!-- GENERATED by cad/manifest.py.  Do not edit: run `python cad/build_all.py`. -->

Bambu H2C, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers.  **No supports on any part** -- every
model is emitted in its print orientation and every overhang is at 45 degrees
or steeper.  Where a part is listed as ASA, the reason is UV and heat: it lives
outdoors or against a warm drill.  Everything else is PETG.

Bed checked against 350 x 320 x 325 mm (`printer_x/y/z` in params.py -- confirm against your machine).


> **The rule, unchanged:** printed parts GUIDE, FEED, ALIGN, SCREEN, COVER and
> SEAL-ASSIST.  None of them contains pressure or carries structural load.  The
> fab jigs are shop tools: none of them stays in the pressure path, and the two
> PTR weld fixtures are sacrificial and must be off the work before weld-out.

- **auger_segment_p65** -- flight self-supports: 97% layer overlap. No supports.
- **auger_scavenger_p65_L65** -- sweeps the annulus in front of the gland
- **auger_segment_p84_SPARE** -- coarser pitch. Print only if the primary auger starves.

- **stator_cradle** -- non-structural alignment only
- **stator_strap** -- finger tight only
- **joint_boot_clamp** -- retains an inner-tube boot over the pin joint

- **jig_post_vent** -- used 12 times. Foot butts the post TOP; vent 100 mm down.
- **template_adapter_plate** -- 1:1. Outline is also the cut mark.
- **template_discharge_flange** -- 1:1
- **template_barrel_rear_flange** -- 1:1
- **fixture_ptr_corner_SACRIFICIAL** -- TACK ONLY. Remove before weld-out or you melt it into the joint.
- **fixture_ptr_tee_SACRIFICIAL** -- TACK ONLY. Remove before weld-out.
- **gauge_tie_rod_spacers** -- two lanes: SERVICE and BREAK-IN. All four spacers must gauge the same.

- **drill_cradle_saddle** -- CLAMPING LOAD ONLY. Torque goes through the steel lug and upright.

- **sand_screen_retainer** -- 8 x M4 traps the cloth
- **hopper_funnel** -- walls lean ~14 deg from vertical; no supports
- **npt_dust_cap** -- debris cap, NOT a pressure cap
- **packing_cone** -- seats each ring square in the box
- **packing_drift** -- half-shell; two make a tube


## Totals

- **56 printed parts** in 28 distinct models.
- Estimated filament: **8.2 kg** (at the listed infills; 'Est. g' is density x perimeter shell volume plus infill fraction of the remainder -- a budgeting number, not a slicer).
- PETG **4.7 kg**, ASA **3.4 kg**.  Buy 6 kg and 4 kg: the auger set alone is a consumable you will reprint, and one
  of the sacrificial weld fixtures will get too close to an arc.
- Of that, **2.9 kg is one-time fab jigs** that do not stay on the machine.  That is the price of
  drilling 24 post holes and a hopper slot right the first time.

## Print order

1. **Jigs first.** `jig_barrel_hopper_slot`, both `jig_barrel_*` rings and the
   three 1:1 templates, before you cut any steel. `gauge_tie_rod_spacers` before
   you cut the spacers -- that gauge is what stops you crushing the stator.
2. **PTR fixtures** before the frame day. Print 4 of each; they are sacrificial
   and one will get too close to an arc.
3. **Post jigs** before you touch the twelve posts. One print, 24 holes.
4. **Wetted parts** during the frame build: augers, gland follower, lantern ring,
   cradle, strap. Print the spare set at the same time.
5. **Operational parts** last: drill cradle, guard tiles, sand screen, funnel,
   dust caps, packing tools.
